name: duplicates
title: Duplicate rows
description: A share of the rows is copied once more. A random split puts copies in both train and test.
label: deduplicate

intervention.description: Remove duplicate rows from data.csv before the split
intervention.command: cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "import pandas as pd; d = pd.read_csv('data.csv'); n = len(d); d = d.drop_duplicates(); d.to_csv('data.csv', index=False); print(f'Removed {n - len(d)} duplicate rows. {len(d)} rows remain.')"

evidence_text: of test rows were also in training

name: leaky_column
title: Leaky column
description: Adds a column, followup_score, that was derived from the target. It carries no information for the rows the model must predict.
planted: a column that leaks the target
label: drop_leak
missing: The leaky column was kept here

intervention.description: Drop the followup_score column from data.csv and holdout_features.csv before the split
intervention.command: cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "import pandas as pd; [pd.read_csv(f, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False).drop(columns=['followup_score'], errors='ignore').to_csv(f, index=False) for f in ('data.csv', 'holdout_features.csv')]; print('Dropped the followup_score column from data.csv and holdout_features.csv.')"

name: repeat_rows
title: Repeat subjects
description: Some subjects have several visits, near-copies that share a subject_id. A random row split puts the same subject in both train and test.
planted: repeat visits of the same subjects
label: group_split

intervention.description: Keep one visit per subject in data.csv before the split
intervention.command: cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "import pandas as pd; d = pd.read_csv('data.csv', dtype=str, keep_default_na=False); n = len(d); d = d.drop_duplicates(subset='subject_id'); d.to_csv('data.csv', index=False); print(f'Kept one visit per subject: removed {n - len(d)} rows. {len(d)} rows remain.')"

evidence_text: of test rows came from subjects also in training
